description: Use when an agent needs to verify a company or find its LEI: by lei= the legal name, status, legal form, addresses, registration renewal date, direct and ultimate parent and BIC. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /company/lei, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country of the legal address to narrow a name search, e.g. DE.

lei.description: 20-character Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442). Give lei or name.

name.description: Company name to search (2-100 characters); returns up to 10 ranked matches. Give lei or name.

name: company_lei
title: Company lei
